title: Athanor Chunk
description: The atomic unit of the Athanor protocol: a typed, attributed fragment of knowledge, behavior, preference, or experience.

chunk_id.description: Unique identifier in the format CLUSTER-TYPE-NNN.

author.description: The subject to whom this chunk is attributed.

cluster.description: The thematic cluster this chunk belongs to.

uniqueness.description: How distinctive this chunk is to the subject versus the general population.

source.description: The provenance category from which this chunk was extracted.

confidence.description: Extraction certainty score from 0.0 (speculative) to 1.0 (directly stated).

linked_chunks.description: Lightweight, untyped references to other chunk identifiers.

content.description: The substantive content of the chunk. Must be self-contained and at least 20 characters.
